dossiers.thesis_summary: Vir Biotechnology's resolving catalyst is the registrational Phase 3 ECLIPSE 1 chronic-hepatitis-delta topline (tobevibart + elebsiran) — a dated, binding, idiosyncratic clinical binary due Q4 2026 (fully enrolled ~120 pts; Breakthrough/Fast Track/PRIME/Orphan). Downside is anchored by ~$5/sh net cash (pro forma the $315M Astellas payment; runway into 2H 2028) plus an Astellas-validated oncology option (VIR-5500 PSMA); a win re-rates toward the ~$20 Street franchise value. Asymmetry is live pipeline option value, NOT a contractual arbitrage.
dossiers.dated_milestone: ECLIPSE 1 Phase 3 chronic hepatitis delta topline expected Q4 2026 (tobevibart + elebsiran; fully enrolled ~120 pts). Secondary: ECLIPSE 2/3 topline Q1 2027; VIR-5818 HER2 Phase 1 dose-escalation data 2H 2026.
dossiers.kill_risk: Pure clinical binary with NO contractual downside protection — no CVR, deal-break price, or financing backstop. An ECLIPSE 1 Phase 3 miss drops the stock toward, and could briefly overshoot below, ~$5/sh net cash (~-48% from $9.67), so the downside floor is SOFT, not hard. Single-readout risk: positive Phase 2 SOLSTICE (Week 96, presented EASL May 2026) de-risks but does not guarantee registrational success. Also, the biggest validation catalyst (Astellas oncology deal) already fired and drove the ~+130% run off the 52wk low, so a large part of the pipeline optionality is already in the tape.

director.memo: Held book unchanged this run: 14/20 seats, 72% invested — clusters Deal-completion 31, Idiosyncratic 29.5, FDA/biotech 11.5 (all under the 40-pt cap). This was an event-triggered PROMOTION check on the single survivor, VIR. DECLINED and NO seat added (picks:[]). Reason: VIR's resolution_driver is FDA_clinical_readout, which the locked held book has at 2/2 (CELC + AMLX, both OPEN) — the freed headroom that triggered this run was an FDA_approval_decision/bio-lane slot (prior VRDN exited; AQST + ZYME now hold FDA_approval_decision), NOT an FDA_clinical_readout seat. Seating VIR would make it the 3rd FDA_clinical_readout name and breach the hard <=2/driver cap, which the downstream validator rejects — so I keep it on-deck rather than force a cap breach, exactly per the 'never breach a combined cap' rule. VIR's edge is genuinely live (EV ~+43%, R:R ~2.15:1 to a soft $5 net-cash floor, dated Q4-2026 topline confirmed) and it remains first-in-line: the moment CELC or AMLX resolves, VIR seats at ~2% as EQUITY (the option chain can't clear a Q4-2026 readout by +1 monthly). All 9 carried on-deck names re-nominated to the watchlist to stay tracked — VIR with a stance_change_rationale for the declined promotion, the other 8 unchanged (stance_change_rationale null) since no fresh dossiers were provided. Watchlist driver mix: FDA_clinical_readout 5 (at the 5-name queue cap), FDA_approval_decision 2, Forced_divest_flow 2 — all within limits. Basket holds at 14 seats / 72% invested; 6 seats of headroom remain but no survivor fits an open combined cap at acceptable edge this run.
